$comment: Former Smart bundle names the Loader still answers to. A forward is not a rule in the distribution (a rule of type smart is a Smart component to the registry, and a forward has no element); the Loader installs it at start as a rule with no tags, no assets and one relation, the new name, unless a rule of that name is already defined, and a relation that names a forward is taken as its target, so the element waits for the bundle itself. Each forward is dated and has a change journal record; remove it on remove_after.
